contentEn.title: Skol 645. Exclusive Three Bedroom Apartment with Sea Views
contentEn.summary: free wifi Exclusive 3-bedroom south-facing apartment on the 6th floor of Block B in the well-known Skol building, located on the beachfront of the heart of Marbella, with views to the Mediterranean and surrounded by all amenities and servic
contentEn.description:
free wifi

 Exclusive 3-bedroom south-facing apartment on the 6th floor of Block B in the well-known Skol building, located on the beachfront of the heart of Marbella, with views to the Mediterranean and surrounded by all amenities and services you may need.

 This spacious apartment has been completely renovated with modern taste and top-quality materials. Accommodation comprises: entrance via stairs (unsuitable for people with limited mobility); spacious living room with flat-screen TV and access to the large private terrace with sea views; fully-equipped open kitchen with oven, microwave, ceramic hob, dishwasher, pots, pans, etc.; two north-facing bedrooms with double beds and built-in wardrobes; a third bedroom, south-facing and overlooking the sea, with a double bed. The apartment is equipped with central A/C, high-speed Wi-Fi connection, and private TV connection with international channels (English, French, Russian, Swedish, etc.; feel at home!).

 The Skol cares for the environment, sourcing its energy partially from solar panels.

 🌐 The apartment has its own Wi-Fi, ideal for working remotely.

 ❄ Private central A/C in the bedroom and the living room.

 🏊‍♀️ Among the Skol’s facilities are its three unheated outdoors community pools, open all year round. Sunbeds have a cost of €3 per day, and are occupied on a first-come-first-served basis.

 🔑 Main reception open 24/7 to accommodate late arrivals.

 ☕ Cafeteria open seasonally, with direct access to the promenade from the community gardens.

 🛌 Bed linen and a set of towels (including beach/pool towel) per guest are included in the rental price.

 Come and enjoy your holiday with the leader in vacation rentals in Marbella!

 🚗 If you want a parking space, once your reservation is confirmed, you will receive information about the parking closest to the Skol Building, which you may reserve online through an external company (price and availability on their website).
